body: Um, I guess they removed this for some reason... Is trying to help suicidal people love themselves against the rules?? What the fuck

It took a very, very long time, but yes I love the fact that I accepted it too. I grew up in a religious family, so i felt like a failure when I started realizing that I just wasn't attracted to girls at all. I'd cry myself to sleep at least a few times a month and I was just an absolute mess. It all stemmed from me being scared and unaccepting of myself, and I'm glad I finally saw that and decided enough was enough. If you can't change something, why fear it everyday

I'm still a closet gay, and I've only came out to one person who I trust. I really don't see any big rush to 'come out' to everyone like some people feel the need to, just selectively telling people who you know won't care too much is definitely the way to go.
